question: Можно ли использовать Lumina как поздний стандартный radiation-hydrodynamic baseline для проверки CCC+TL после BBN: thermal/ionization history, optical depth and light-cone observables?
scope_limit: Lumina is a Planck-2018 cosmological simulation from z=49 to 3. It is not CCC+TL, does not cover BBN, and its published outputs do not validate variable-c/G physics. Registration is metadata and donor mapping only; no code/data execution or scientific acceptance is claimed.

decision_points.rationale: Some figure products are available on the project site; full data release is planned for 2028; other data by reasonable request.
Base AREPO is public; GPU AREPO-RT and the Lumina HIP implementation are on request; no pinned public Lumina code commit verified.
Need common a(z), H(z), t(z), clock convention, radiation sources, chemistry and light-cone observable mapping before any comparison.
Lumina is a standard Planck-2018 baseline and does not by itself support or refute CCC+TL.

next_action: Inspect accessible global statistics; request a targeted subset of IGM grids/lightcones and the GPU AREPO-RT/HIP access conditions; prepare a late-epoch CCC+TL mapping contract.
